text:
anya: Quick debrief from today's customer intake (ChimeAI). They want: 1) automatic batching with minimal config, 2) cache suggestions for common prefixes, 3) quantization recommendations per workload, 4) eval-triggered alerts for quality regressions. Notes attached.

matt: thanks. can we map to phased launches? I suggest a tight Phase 1: batching + prefix caching + basic UX in console. Phase 2: quant recs + per-model profiles. Phase 3: eval-alert integration. what's min acceptance criteria?

sara: infra note — continuous batching work is in progress but not GA; perf risk on short-latency SLOs. for Phase 1 we should only enable batching when request latency budget >= 250ms (configurable). Also need prefix cache TTL + eviction policy.

diego: for eval alerts: we can wire into the eval pipeline (evals-service) and emit a signal when per-prompt embedding drift crosses threshold. prefer a plugin model: alert rules = prompt-set + metric + window. example rule: 

```json
{"rule_name":"greeting-drift","metric":"embedding_cos_sim","threshold":0.82,"window":"24h"}
```

kevin: ops question — where do these alerts route? slack? pager? runbooks? we must define severity mapping. also need a tokenized cost impact estimate before enabling auto-suggest.

anya: acceptance criteria draft for Phase 1:
- batching: end-to-end demo on hosted API + dedicated w/ 95th pct latency within SLO for target customer
- prefix cache: observable hit/miss, dashboard panel + cost delta estimate
- UX: single toggle + quickstart (2-min) + sample workloads
- docs: API samples, console screenshots

matt: rough prioritization — 60% of value from batching+cache, so ship Phase 1 ASAP. Quant recs take more infra/ML work.

sara: estimated eng effort: 4w for batching infra + 2w for console/panels + 1w for rollout automation => 7w. we can cut to 5w if we do a limited beta (hosted-only) first.

anya: decision: do hosted-only Beta for Phase 1, gated by: (a) customers in beta list; (b) perf telemetry showing <10% latency regressions; (c) cost savings >= 5% for pilot customers. I'll draft the pilot invite text. @matt can you own acceptance and comms?

matt: yep, i'll own. i'll write the pilot email + launch checklist. @diego can you mock an eval-alert example to include in docs?

diego: on it — will post mock alerts + rule YAML by EOD. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: deploy queued for feature/batching-beta -> staging (pipeline #4523).
